# MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3 Calibration checks - Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-HT03

Scope
- This document defines the calibration check procedure for sensors and timing functions on Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03). Follow referenced process controls and safety steps in MM-P1-L4-HT03 and SOP-P1-L4-02, SOP-P1-L4-03.

Tools
- Manufacturer-recommended calibration instruments and meters per MM-P1-L4-HT03.  
- Consumable lubricant: The lubricant part number for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03) is CFW-LUB-231.  
- Traceable verification tags and log forms as specified in MM-P1-L4-HT03.

Procedure
1. Verify authorization and lockout per SOP-P1-L4-02 before accessing controller terminals.  
2. Confirm power-off and safe condition per SOP-P1-L4-03.  
3. Inspect physical condition of sensors and connections per MM-P1-L4-HT03. Replace or repair only with parts and procedures listed in MM-P1-L4-HT03.  
4. Connect calibrated test instrument to the sensor terminal. Perform zero and span checks following the instrument vendor procedure and the calibration checkpoints in MM-P1-L4-HT03. Record measured values on the calibration log.  
5. Verify timing control relay and digital timer outputs against expected response. When measuring the quench activation timing, record measured delay and compare to acceptance limits. The quench delay maximum for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03) is 15 seconds.  
6. If adjustment is required, adjust per MM-P1-L4-HT03 and recheck. Apply lubricant where required using CFW-LUB-231 and document in maintenance record.  
7. Restore system to operational status per SOP-P1-L4-03 and update calibration tag and records.

Acceptance criteria
- All sensors and timers meet setpoint agreement and functional response defined in MM-P1-L4-HT03.  
- Measured quench delay is within the limit: The quench delay maximum for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03) is 15 seconds.  
- Lubrication recorded using The lubricant part number for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03) is CFW-LUB-231.  
- Any deviation requires corrective action and re-calibration before return to service, per MM-P1-L4-HT03 and SOP-P1-L4-02.
